title: Claude Code statusLine is a single global slot -- multi-plugin composition needs a dispatcher convention
trigger: Designing DD's audit-UI terminal visibility (or any other user-visible persistent indicator) via Claude Code's statusLine feature, especially when other plugins (e.g. caveman) also want a statusLine badge.
behavior_delta: settings.json has exactly one `statusLine` field (type: command, one script/command). Claude Code has no native mechanism for multiple plugins to each contribute a segment -- confirmed against the official statusline docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline): the field runs one command, receives one JSON session blob on stdin, and whatever it prints (including multiple lines via multiple echo/print calls) is the whole status line. If DD needs to coexist with another plugin's statusLine ask (e.g. caveman's pending `[CAVEMAN]` badge), do not just overwrite the single slot -- propose a dispatcher pattern instead: a shared convention directory (e.g. ~/.claude/statusline.d/*.js), one small script per plugin dropped there, and a single aggregator script (configured once as the actual statusLine.command) that runs each file and joins their output as separate lines. This scales to N plugins without re-touching settings.json per addition, but it is a convention DD would have to invent and document, not something Claude Code provides or enforces -- a plugin that doesn't follow it still has to be integrated by hand.

why: User asked whether the statusLine slot necessarily conflicts across plugins and whether there's an easy way to scale to 3+ plugins wanting to use it. Read the official Claude Code statusline docs in full (fetched via WebFetch, code.claude.com/docs/en/statusline) to confirm there is exactly one settings.json slot and no built-in multi-source composition, then reasoned out the dispatcher-directory pattern as the only real scaling path, informed by the ongoing decision to show DD's audit UI URL via statusLine (per hooks/session-start/claude-code-output-model-only) while caveman's plugin separately wants the same slot for its badge.
trigger_variants: Can DD have its own status line separate from other plugins?
statusLine conflicts with another plugin's badge
how to show multiple plugin indicators in Claude Code's status bar

revisit_when.description: Re-check the statusline docs if a future Claude Code release adds native multi-source/plugin statusLine composition.

evidence_refs.summary: Docs confirm statusLine is a single settings.json field of type 'command' running one script; 'What your script can output' section documents multiple lines/colors/links from that one script, but nothing about multiple independently-configured statusLine sources being merged by Claude Code itself.
